propositions: Code-review provenance (--ref/--source/source/verified_at_sha) must flow through CodeReviewRequest and match the pattern established by four sibling producers
Snapshot-entry contract enforcement must be delegated to CI schema-drift gates rather than asserted in documentation
LLM-Review votes must provably attach to the exact tree revision that was reviewed, preventing attestation staleness from source-code drift
Exit-codes documentation and CI conformance must cover every dispatcher arm and emitted code path, with automated enforcement preventing drift
Deprecated config files must respect the deprecation registry behavior field; validate --fix must not advertise repairs it does not perform
All library read paths must be unable to terminate the host process; comment triage and ADR collisions must be resolved to permit deterministic change ordering
